result.summary: Found 2 visual issues related to bottom navigation safe area overlap and text truncation in card carousels.

issues.description: System gesture bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons due to missing bottom safe area padding.
issues.suggestion: Add safe area insets to the bottom navigation bar to prevent UI overlap.

issues.description: Restaurant name in the horizontal carousel cuts off abruptly at the edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper text wrapping or ellipsis truncation for card labels.
